quest.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quest.description: After touching the bonsai, everyone enters some kind of mysterious mirage — an old mansion where the long-forgotten past of a clan resurfaces... This place is intimately linked to Kaedehara Kazuha.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Hoverlight Rocks: Left x1, Hoverlight Rocks: Right x1

chapter.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared

talks.objective: Look around for the items you need
Place the rock into the bonsai

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's a new place!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: As was the case last time, only Lord Kazuha is missing.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Don't worry, leave it to us!

talks.objective: Explore the area and look for an exit
Explore the area and look for an exit

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: ...This will do. Ah, Kazuha, you've come just at the right moment. What do you think of this rock carving?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's very intricate.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: I based it on a mountain scene I saw in a book. You know, there are nations in this world where the mountains reach all the way up into the clouds. If only I had the chance to see them with my own eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Father, you can go anywhere whenever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: That's not true. Though the Kaedehara Clan is far from what it used to be, I still bear all the same responsibilities as the clan heads before me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: But then again... continuing in the way of our forefathers, sacrificing everything for our declining clan... is it really worth it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But I... I don't understand.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: ...Kazuha, there's one thing I want you to always remember.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Family ties are important, but you ought to not let them hold you back.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Family only exists because of the people in it. If we are unhappy, how can we hope to build a joyful one?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: The events of the past have had a profound impact on our family, but they are not your burden to carry.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: ...If you ever grow tired of this tedious life, just drop everything and go off on a journey, see the world. Remember, Kazuha, don't let yourself get tied down in life.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, father.

talks.objective: Enter the dojo and defeat the opponent(s)
Operate the device and enter the new space
Explore the area and look for an exit

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I just don't understand!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Kazuha, have you forgotten our promise?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You really want to give it all up? But... but even if we're having a rough time, you still have me by your side! Can't I be of any help?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When you were my age, you were already helping grandfather out! Am I so incompetent that I'm a disappointment to you? Or...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Kazuha!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Now you're blaming yourself for all of this... That's why I have failed you as a father.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: The Kaedehara Clan has been paying the price for our past mistakes ever since your great-grandfather's generation. To this day, we have never fully recovered from it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Though we are a family of bladesmiths, you don't have to devote your life to the family craft.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: If a wounded animal wants to escape from a trap, it has to sacrifice the hind leg that was caught. You might think of this as a loss, but staying in the trap has far more deadly consequences.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Enough now, Kazuha. As the head of the family, I failed to revitalize our clan. You never blamed me for not giving you the life promised to you by our heritage, and I'm grateful enough for that.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: All these generations of suffering... let's end them today. From now on, live your life with no burdens.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'll carry the blame for abandoning our family business.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Father, please don't... You should not be to blame for not upholding our family name.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Even if that day comes, let me share the burden with you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's just wait and see. Sooner or later, I will have to lead the Kaedehara Clan. When the time comes, I'll deal with all our problems.

talks.objective: Enter the dojo and defeat the opponent(s)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... why can't he hear us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like it's just an illusion. This isn't the Kazuha who came here with us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thought we might find you trapped here again.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Haha, yeah, it seems those are the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We entered that maze in the mirage again, but the scene was different this time.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Kazuha what you saw...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The mood was more deflated, and the place more humbly furnished... yes, that makes sense.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What you saw was the Kaedehara Clan in decline.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We saw you in the mirage too, but you looked a little different than now.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Indeed, I most certainly agree.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Compared to the Lord Kazuha before us now, the mirage we saw appeared lost, with the burden of fate weighing heavily upon him.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I can confirm that. His fate was a heavy burden indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That means I am older and wiser now. I am sorry you had to see my less mature former self.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: For a long time after leaving Inazuma, I've lived the life of a drifter. But this is no bad thing, because I learned much from the experience.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I wish that I could've met my past self, too. If he saw me, I know that he would understand:

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Life is a long journey, and that's why I must travel far and wide.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Just as I thought, the bonsai is the key to entering the mirage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's continue looking for the rock garden.
